main_topics.reason: The user wanted to understand alternatives to Humira and why another anti-TNF was being recommended after infliximab stopped working.
The user said the consultant brushed off questions and others treated them as awkward for wanting to understand the decision.
The user described being furious and later said they felt more in control instead of just angry.
The user said no one had mentioned blood tests, and testing levels and antibodies became part of the questions they planned to raise.
The user asked whether requesting a second opinion through the NHS could cause problems and said they had worried about going behind the consultant's back.

output.summary: The user was angry that a switch from infliximab to Humira seemed decided without their input, and wanted to understand other treatment options and the rationale for the switch. The assistant discussed alternatives, testing to ask about, appointment questions, and requesting a second opinion. The user said they felt more in control, planned to book an appointment, and would take their questions with them.
